structured.answer: The site says it doesn't calculate a long list of things yet: gold (ETC, gold ETFs), corporate and Israel bonds, insurance-savings products (ביטוח מנהלים, קופת ביטוח, קרן י', ביטוח משתתף ברווחים), foreign-currency and dollar-linked deposits, structured deposits and products, REITs, pension annuity things and a digital currency wallet. I didn't see plain S&P/Nasdaq index funds on the list, but I stopped scrolling partway through.

No summary or count at the top of what's missing
Dense legal citations and law names in every card
Crossed-out 'נסגר ב' lines and codes like TXA-28 are confusing

Lots of jargon with no plain explanation for beginners
